phase_policies.applies_when: At around 180 seconds, both sides are in the early game with heavy economy and technology, but the opponent's posture is unknown.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have more information about the opponent's composition or if you scout an aggressive move.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and tech development, scout for opponent intentions, and maintain a defensive ground core to survive early pressure.
phase_policies.target: Continue to develop your economy and technology, while scouting to determine the opponent's intentions. Build a solid foundation for your midgame.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Tech and Economy Focus
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to economy and tech without ensuring defensive capability, especially if the opponent shows early pressure like Reaper harassment.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 300 seconds, both sides have a heavy economy and production, with the opponent showing a ground posture and possible pressure.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if the opponent shows signs of a heavy push or if you scout a tech switch. Adjust your defensive and tech priorities accordingly.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balance economy and tech with ground army strength, maintain defense, and scout for pressure to avoid being caught off guard.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing your economy and technology, strengthen your ground army, and maintain a defensive posture while scouting for pressure.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Ground Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect defensive capability while expanding and teching; ensure you have a solid ground army to defend against potential pressure.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 480-540 seconds, the opponent has a heavy ground army with Medivacs, and you have a solid economy but need to strengthen your army.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if the opponent shows signs of a large push or if you scout a tech switch. Adjust your production and tech priorities accordingly.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on strengthening ground army through production and tech, while preserving economy and expansion lead to support sustained pressure.
phase_policies.target: Increase your production and technology to strengthen your ground army, while maintaining your economy and expansion lead.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army Strengthening
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend production and tech without ensuring your army composition can handle the opponent's ground forces, especially with Medivac support.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 600 seconds, the opponent has a heavy ground army with Siege Tanks and Medivacs, and you have a strong economy but need to solidify your army.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if the opponent shows signs of a large push or if you scout a tech switch. Adjust your composition accordingly.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Solidify ground army with tech units and upgrades, maintain economy and expansion lead, and stay positioned to counter the opponent's heavy ground forces.
phase_policies.target: Continue to strengthen your ground army with tech units like Immortals and Colossi, while maintaining your economy and expansion lead.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Ground Army with Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect upgrades and positioning; ensure your army composition counters the opponent's Siege Tanks and Medivacs effectively.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
